silhouette.reason: Pointed ears, long snout, black stockings, a full brush and shorter legs read unmistakably as a red fox in hero.png and SIDE.
fixes: thinner ear shells with a sharper tip

proportions.reason: Legs are shorter and the chest deeper now; the trunk reads slightly heavy and barrel-deep for Vulpes vulpes.
fixes: slim the belly line ~5% behind the ribcage

materials.reason: The near-black peppering is gone: card ends now shade orange-brown and the coat reads as fur (hero.png, flank and back), with cream chest, black stockings and a furred brush; the ear tip is no longer a flat grey card. The ear backs are orange where a red fox has black ones, the inner ear is a flat grey cup, and the face is a smooth plane.
fixes: black ear backs and a furred inner ear instead of a flat grey cup
short fur cards on the face
fewer snow flecks on the back in the sheet views so the topline does not look frosted grey

detail.reason: Whiskers and brush fur; the paws now split into toes with small dark claws and a brow ridge sits over the eye; the cheek planes are still soft.
fixes: thin dark lip line and ear-edge fringe

wear.reason: Mud is graded from dark toes up the stockings, snow lies as flecks along the topline, in the brush and now on the ear tip (hero.png), so the coat reads lived-in; the legs show no damp clumping.
fixes: damp clumped fur on the lower legs
a few matted locks on the belly fringe

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 holds the outline, black legs, smooth even coat colour and the white tail tip; the switch is quiet. Small dark flecks remain on the LOD2 back and two pale slash marks show on the flank and shoulder.
fixes: drop the dark speck flecks and pale slashes from the LOD2 coat

technical.reason: QA clean; 86.6k / 27.8k / 3.9k tris, 4 / 4 / 2 draws: LOD0 within the fur-card budget.
